trip.title: Baltimore → California
trip.subtitle: LA, the Pacific Coast Highway, redwoods & San Francisco
trip.notes: Open-jaw: fly into LAX, home from SFO. Carry-on only. Gas/hybrid crossover, not an EV. Eating leans healthier and veg-forward, with the odd treat — veg picks noted per day. In SF, park the car at the hotel and walk / cable-car / rideshare; you only really need it for the Muir Woods morning. This plan is a menu, not a schedule — hit the anchors and pivot as the day feels. Dates are placeholders aligned to a Saturday arrival so markets and closures line up; shift the whole thing in one block if you pick another week.

days.label: Arrive · Saturday
days.title: Land, grab the car, ease in

beats.text: Land at LAX, pick up the rental, drive to the Mid-Wilshire / WeHo base — 30–45 min, but the LAX exit plus weekend traffic can double it. No tight plans tonight.
Easy first dinner near the base, no reservation: veg-friendly bowls at Kismet (Los Feliz), or tacos at Sonoratown if you're craving them.

days.fuel: If you land early: Maru Coffee (Los Feliz) or Go Get Em Tiger (Larchmont).

days.label: Los Angeles · Sunday
days.title: The Getty by day, Griffith at dusk

beats.text: The Getty — reserve the parking slot ahead (that's effectively the ticket; entry's free), then tram up. Wander the Central Garden, pavilions, and the terrace view at your own pace. Half-day, no rush.
Lunch veg-friendly: the Getty restaurant does proper salads and veg plates; or drop to Sawtelle for veg ramen / a grain bowl.

Griffith Observatory near sunset. Parking fills and the road clogs — easiest to rideshare up or take the DASH Observatory shuttle from the Vermont/Sunset Metro. Lawn for the Hollywood-sign view, then the exhibits.

days.fuel: Coffee on the way up: Maru Coffee (Los Feliz). Backup: Dinosaur Coffee on Sunset.

days.label: Los Angeles · Monday
days.title: Universal Studios

beats.text: Rope-drop it — leave by ~8:00, since the 101 to Universal City clogs later. Prepay parking to skip a bottleneck at the gate.

Studio Tour first, then the headliners before crowds build. Veg options are fine in-park (Springfield / CityWalk) — nothing precious, but you won't go hungry. An Express Pass earns its keep on a busy day.
Back over the hill for a low-key dinner near the base.

days.fuel: Caffeinate before you go — park coffee is mediocre. Cafe Dulce or Maru. Bring a water bottle.

days.label: Los Angeles · Tuesday
days.title: A beach walk and a proper eating day

beats.text: El Matador State Beach, Malibu (~45 min on PCH, lighter before 10). Small paid lot up top, then stairs down to the coves — go early for a spot. Backup: Point Dume up the road.
The one 'treat' lunch: Langer's #19 pastrami downtown (Tue, lunch only). Want it lighter/veg instead? Grand Central Market a block over — veg bowls and great produce. Park in a lot, not the meters.
Nice LA dinner: Bestia (Arts District, book 3–4 wks out — valet or a lot; street parking's rough there). Veg-forward alt: Kismet; splurge: the n/naka tasting menu.

days.fuel: Afternoon coffee: Verve on Melrose; west side → Great White or Gjusta in Venice.

days.label: LA → Cambria · Wed · ~4.5–5 hr + stops
days.title: Up the coast to Cambria

beats.text: Leave by ~8:00 to clear LA. Santa Barbara ~1.5 hr up — stretch, coffee, an early lunch, a block of State St. (La Super-Rica's closed Wed; the Santa Barbara Public Market has good veg options instead.)
North ~2.5 hr. Optional Hearst Castle tour (pre-book a time). Piedras Blancas elephant seals — free boardwalk right off Hwy 1, quick and always worth it.
Into Cambria: Moonstone Beach boardwalk at golden hour, dinner in the village, olallieberry pie at Linn's.

days.fuel: Santa Barbara: Handlebar Coffee or Helena Avenue Bakery. Cambria: Cambria Coffee Roasting Co.

days.label: Cambria → SF · Thu · ~6 hr + stops
days.title: Big Sur, the redwoods, into the city

beats.text: Gas up in Cambria (sparse services ahead) and start by ~8:30 to beat the fog. Long, beautiful driving day — let the drive be the plan.
Big Sur pull-outs, south → north: Ragged Point, the McWay Falls overlook, Bixby Creek Bridge. Stop whenever it's pretty; don't clock-watch.
Nepenthe — cliffside terrace, veg-friendly (good sandwiches and salads), the classic Big Sur view. Backup: Big Sur Bakery further north.
REDWOODS #1 if you've got energy: the flat Henry Cowell Redwood Grove loop near Santa Cruz (~45 min) — otherwise roll on, Muir Woods is tomorrow. Into SF, park at the hotel, easy dinner.

days.fuel: Café Kevah at Nepenthe for the view; the Verve Coffee flagship in Santa Cruz for the last push.

days.label: San Francisco · Friday
days.title: The bridge and the big trees

beats.text: Muir Woods over the Golden Gate (~40 min). Timed parking/shuttle reservation is mandatory — book it. Flat creek loop under the big trees, ~1 hr. This is the one day you actually need the car.
Golden Gate Bridge on the way back — Battery Spencer on the Marin side for the classic head-on shot.
Lands End cliff walk (Legion of Honor → Sutro Baths), or ease off at the Palace of Fine Arts + Chestnut St. Park the car back at the hotel afterward — you won't need it again until SFO.
Nice SF dinner: Zuni Café (roast chicken for two; strong veg too). Veg-forward alt: Greens at Fort Mason — iconic vegetarian with a bridge view — or Shizen for vegan sushi.

days.fuel: Coffee before Muir: Saint Frank (Russian Hill) or Réveille.

days.label: San Francisco · Saturday
days.title: Waterfront, the Rock, and eating around town

beats.text: Ferry Building — Saturday farmers' market out front (~8am–2pm): Hog Island oysters, produce, Blue Bottle, veg everywhere. All walkable / cable-car — leave the car parked.
Alcatraz (pre-booked; ferry from Pier 33). Half a day with the boat; the cellhouse audio tour is the good part.
Waterfront to the Wharf + Pier 39 sea lions, up into North Beach & Chinatown, cable car back up Nob Hill. Snack: Swan Oyster Depot (Sat open, counter, lunch) or veg dim sum at Good Mong Kok.
Casual close-out: a veggie Mission burrito at La Taqueria, or North Beach Italian. Pastry nightcap: Tartine.

days.fuel: Ferry Building coffee (Blue Bottle / Sightglass); later a cortado at Caffe Trieste in North Beach.

days.label: Depart · Sunday
days.title: One last coffee, then home

beats.text: By flight time: a croissant at b. Patisserie or Arsicault, or the Painted Ladies at Alamo Square. Then SFO — leave a buffer to refuel and return the car.
SFO → BWI. Carry-on only means a straight walk out, no baggage claim.

days.fuel: Last coffee: b. Patisserie or Mr. Holmes Bakehouse.

reservations.name: Rental car — LAX pickup, SFO drop
reservations.notes: Gas or hybrid crossover/sedan (not an EV). One-way drop at SFO — expect a modest one-way fee.

reservations.name: Getty Center parking reservation
reservations.notes: Entry is free; reserve the parking slot ahead.

reservations.name: Universal Studios Hollywood
reservations.notes: Dated ticket. Consider Express Pass + prepaid parking on a busy day.

reservations.name: Bestia (nice LA dinner)
reservations.notes: Book ~3–4 wks out. Valet/lot. Veg alt: Kismet. Splurge: n/naka.

reservations.name: Hearst Castle tour (optional)
reservations.notes: Optional en-route stop. Pre-book a tour time if doing it.

reservations.name: Cambria hotel
reservations.notes: 1 night. Small town, limited rooms — book once dates are set. Ask for a Moonstone Beach-side room.

reservations.name: Muir Woods parking / shuttle
reservations.notes: Timed reservation is MANDATORY — no reservation, no entry.

reservations.name: Zuni Café (nice SF dinner)
reservations.notes: Roast chicken for two. Veg alt: Greens (Fort Mason) or Shizen. Book ahead.

reservations.name: Alcatraz ferry + tour
reservations.notes: Sells out weeks ahead — book first. Day or night tour.

reservations.name: SF hotel (Nob Hill)
reservations.notes: 3 nights. 3★+. Confirm on-site parking (~$60–70/night) since the car sits idle here.

checklists.name: Book these early
items: Flights — open-jaw BWI→LAX / SFO→BWI, premium economy (2–3 mo out)
Alcatraz tickets (4–8 wk out — the true sellout)
Universal Studios dated tickets (+ Express Pass?)
Bestia (LA) + Zuni or Greens (SF); n/naka if splurging
Getty parking reservation; Hearst Castle tour if adding
Cambria hotel (limited inventory — book once dates are set)
Rental car — one-way LAX pickup, SFO drop
Re-check Big Sur / Hwy 1 road status closer to the date

checklists.name: Packing (carry-on only)
items: Layers — SF mornings & Big Sur run cool and foggy
Light rain shell, just in case
Phone car mount + charging cable for the drive
Download the Google Maps offline area for Big Sur
